attribution: Basemap copied from Ironfall BlueMap. BlueMap is an open-source map renderer; world imagery remains attributed to the Ironfall server.
notes: Terrain color only; original 3D geometry, live players, claims and live markers are not included.
The last overlapping color column and row are removed from each tile before stitching.
Shader samples unflipped image data; raw PNG top = minimum Z, left = minimum X.
Map geometry maps pixel centers at +0.5 times LOD scale, so no geographic reprojection is needed.
